The manuscript is in preparation/to be submitted, but too busy to
polish up those last 3% :(

The main idea is very similar to the CRMA paper (10K-500K platforms).
Some special handling of the CN probes and the fact that GWS5/GWS6 are
not co-digested with two enzymes. The model/algorithms been ready,
tested and pretty much the same since November, so don't worry about
big modifications if you start using it.

Cheers
